<<A WORD ABOUT MAPPING A SMALL ORCHARD>>

MAP A SMALL ORCHARD FOR A NEIGHBORHOOD NEWSLETTER  
BEGIN BY IDENTIFYING THE LOCATION AND SIZE OF THE ORCHARD. USE A MAP TO MARK THE PLACES WHERE FRUITS WILL BE PLANTED. NOTE THE TYPES OF FRUITS AND THEIR GROWTH REQUIREMENTS. RECORD THE LOCATION OF WATERING HOLE AND SUNLIGHT EXPOSURE. MARK THE LOCATION OF THE ORCHARD IN THE NEWSLETTER. INCLUDE A DIAGRAM SHOWING THE PLANTING SCHEDULE AND FERTILIZER NEEDS. MAKE SURE TO INCLUDE A LIST OF MATERIALS NEEDED FOR THE PROJECT. FINISH WITH A SUMMARY OF THE PROJECT AND A CALL TO ACTION FOR THE NEIGHBORHOOD TO PARTICIPATE.  

A WORD ABOUT MAPPING A SMALL ORCHARD  
THE ORCHARD IS A HUB OF LIFE, A PLACE WHERE NEIGHBORS CAN COLLABORATE AND SHARE. IT IS A WAY TO CONNECT THE COMMUNITY AND PROMOTE GROWTH AND HEALTH. THE MAP IS NOT JUST A TOOL BUT A WAY TO SHOW OFF THE ORCHARD’S POTENTIAL. IT IS A WAY TO EDUCATE AND INVOLVE THE NEIGHBORHOOD IN THE GROWTH OF FRUITS AND VEGETABLES. THE MAP IS A GUIDE FOR PLANTING, WATERING, AND CULTIVATING. IT IS A WAY TO SHOW OFF THE ORCHARD’S BLOOMING POTENTIAL AND ITS ROLE IN THE COMMUNITY.
